title: ロボティクス統合演習Ⅰ
subtitle: Advanced Robotics Seminar I
keywords: Robot element design technology 2.System integration technology 3.Intelligent information technology
educationalGoal: Acquire the skills necessary for engineering by integrating the knowledge and skills acquired so far and learning new topics related to mechanical and robot engineering. Learn to apply this knowledge to benefit society. In addition, summarize your opinions and ideas from a broad perspective to develop the ability to think logically and thoroughly.
advice: The course summary is introduced in class handouts to provide new topics. During lectures, specialized research and cutting-edge topics are introduced by faculty members and off-campus engineers.

activityGoals.body: Acquire basic knowledge of machine-related fields and apply it to specialized fields
Apply the knowledge and skills necessary for robot design and production
Proactively acquire expertise in the field of robotics
Solve problems by understanding the nature of the problem and integrating the knowledge and skills
Organize and perform tasks systematically under given constraints

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
